integrity: All reported face counts, acyclic matching tests, and homology checks are generated by a standalone deterministic program. Independent external validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite 27-vertex case, not the full three-factor conjecture. A prior conjecture explicitly predicted the number 46; what is established here is its homotopy realization and the complete Hamming Rips filtration. No claim is made for arbitrarily large alphabets or dimensions.
title: The ternary Hamming Rips filtration and the \(K_3\times K_3\times K_3\) case
